## Definition of Done

- [ ] Acceptance criteria are covered by tests, tagged with their AC id
- [ ] Production code changes come with test changes
- [ ] No company, product or client names anywhere in the change
- [ ] Anything not fixed is written down as a known risk with an owner

<!-- This checklist is a reminder. The CI check is what enforces the gate. -->
